title: Getting Lost in the Marrakech Souks (On Purpose This Time)
description: The first time I entered the medina I lasted forty minutes before paying a teenager to walk me out. This time I went in with a strategy: no maps, a hard budget in small notes, and a rule that every wrong turn earns a mint tea. How to haggle without being a jerk, where the lantern souk actually is, and why Jemaa el-Fnaa is better at 8am than 8pm.

comments.comment: 'Every wrong turn earns a mint tea' is the only medina navigation system that has ever worked. Stealing this.
